'''March 2001 Smyrna tournament (31 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Champions, Smyrna, GA on 31 March 2001. [[Charlie Herren]] won it. It is known from Adam Drake's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2024">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-05-ta-black-goes-to-buford-3-31-01d2024/ ta-black-goes-to-buford-3-31-01], DeckTech (Adam "ADrake" Drake, 5 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-05-ta-black-goes-to-buford-3-31-01d2024/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 31 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Champions, Smyrna, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Charlie Herren]]
